figures.finding: Professional tax for 2026 is 0% on the first MOP 144,000 of assessable income, then 7% to 164,000, 8% to 184,000, 9% to 224,000, 10% to 304,000, 11% to 424,000 and 12% above, after a standard 25% deduction; the 2026 budget cuts the resulting tax by 30%.
figures.applies: Tax year 2026, employees and self-employed. The MOP 144,000 exemption, the MOP 198,000 exemption at 65 or 60% disability and the 30% reduction are the DSF's own (Law 13/2025, the 2026 Budget Law); the band edges above 144,000 and their rates are PwC's, the DSF's scale page and the Regulamento do Imposto Profissional not being readable here.

sources.said: 根據第13/2025號法律《2026年財政年度預算案》，2026年由財政局專責處理之稅務優惠包括如下： … 職業稅稅額扣減項目之扣減率訂定為百分之三十，豁免額訂定為$144,000（澳門元壹拾肆萬肆仟元）。另外，年齡六十五歲以上或經證實為永久傷殘程度等於或高於百分之六十的僱員及散工，年度豁免額調升至$198,000（澳門元壹拾玖萬捌仟元）。

For the tax year 2026, the professional tax rates are progressive and cumulative up to a maximum rate of 12%. Assessable income (MOP) Marginal cumulative tax liability (MOP) Each range (%) Over Not over 0 144,000 0 0 144,000 164,000 1,400 7 164,000 184,000 3,000 8 184,000 224,000 6,600 9 224,000 304,000 14,600 10 304,000 424,000 27,800 11 424,000 and above 12

There will be a 30% reduction in the Macau professional tax liabilities for income derived in the tax year 2026. Together with the standard 25% deduction on the taxable income granted under the Macau Professional Tax Law, the effective tax rate for Macau professional tax is below 6.3%.
For employees over the age of 65 or proved to be 60% disabled or above, the tax-free income threshold will be further increased to MOP 198,000 for the tax year 2026.
A standard deduction of 25% of taxable income is available for both self-employed individuals and salaried employees.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; the employer files quarterly returns (15 January, April, July, October) and the annual M3/M4 return by the end of February.

value.annualReturn: end of February of the following year

sources.said: The Macau tax year is the calendar year.

The quarterly professional tax return is due on 15 of January, April, July, and October of each year. The annual professional tax return (namely 'M3/M4') is due by the end of February of the following year.

figures.finding: Employers withhold professional tax monthly from salaries (PAYE) and remit it by the 15th of the month after each quarter.

sources.said: There is a pay-as-you-earn (PAYE) system, similar to those used in other countries, which is applicable to salaried individuals only.

figures.finding: Professional tax applies to anyone paid for work performed in Macau, resident or not; a foreign freelancer or artist engaged by a Macau entity without a valid work visa pays the higher of 5% of taxable income and the progressive scale.

value.rate: max(5% of taxable income, progressive scale)
value.appliesTo: foreign freelancers and artists without valid work visas

sources.said: Foreign freelancers and artists engaged by Macau entities without valid work visas are taxed at the higher of 5% on taxable income and the tax amount arrived by applying the progressive tax rate table on taxable income.

figures.finding: Social security is a flat MOP 90 a month for a resident employee: MOP 60 from the employer and MOP 30 from the employee.

sources.said: A total contribution of MOP 90 per month is payable for resident employees. The employer contributes two-thirds of the amount (i.e. MOP 60) and the employee contributes one-third of the amount (i.e. MOP 30).

figures.finding: Macau has no VAT or general sales tax: consumption tax falls only on tobacco and spirits.

sources.said: Consumption tax is imposed only on tobacco and spirits entering into Macau SAR.
